melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.e.label: executor_code_cache
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.e.role: Process-wide compiled-executor code-object cache for identity-free emitted source.
responsibilities: deduplicates compile() of identity-free emitted executor source by source hash
keeps the cache bounded with lock-light FIFO eviction
provides observability and maintenance helpers for cached compiled code objects
